annotations.title: Funding & OI — one coin, by venue

description: Venue-by-venue breakdown for a single coin: what each major liquid venue — Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid, the largest perpetual DEX — shows for funding and open interest, taken from that venue's largest-open-interest perpetual. Returns the per-venue rows plus the average funding, total open interest in USD and the funding spread. Reach for this when divergence between venues matters — one venue far more positive or negative than the rest signals localised positioning rather than market consensus. Takes one coin only; to sweep several at once, call get_derivatives_aggregate. Funding is returned in PERCENT per 8 hours (0.0061 means 0.0061%, not 0.61%) and also ANNUALIZED as a percent per year, so it can be compared directly against any other yield; open interest is in USD. Errors if the coin has no major-venue data. Current snapshot.
